entries.label: Robot dexterity
entries.quote: If robots could learn to deal with the messiness of the real world, they could do many more tasks.

entries.label: New-wave nuclear power
entries.quote: New nuclear designs that have gained momentum in the past year are promising to make this power source safer and cheaper.
entries.note: Availability not read verbatim. Paraphrase returned: new fission designs in the 2020s, fusion after 2030. Check https://www.technologyreview.com/technology/new-wave-nuclear-power/. The article page itself has no Availability label.

entries.label: Predicting preemies
entries.availability: A test could be offered in doctor's offices within five years
entries.quote: 15 million babies are born prematurely every year; it's the leading cause of death for children under age five

entries.label: Gut probe in a pill
entries.availability: Now used in adults; testing in infants begins in 2019
entries.quote: The device makes it easier to screen for and study gut diseases, including one that keeps millions of children in poor countries from growing properly

entries.label: Custom cancer vaccines
entries.quote: Conventional chemotherapies take a heavy toll on healthy cells and aren't always effective against tumors
entries.note: Availability states a trial phase, not a time band.

entries.label: The cow-free burger
entries.quote: Livestock production causes catastrophic deforestation, water pollution, and greenhouse-gas emissions

entries.label: Carbon dioxide catcher
entries.quote: Removing CO2 from the atmosphere might be one of the last viable ways to stop catastrophic climate change

entries.label: An ECG on your wrist
entries.quote: the convenience of a wearable device with something closer to the precision of a medical one
entries.note: Availability not read verbatim. Paraphrase returned: FDA clearance already obtained (i.e. available now). Check https://www.technologyreview.com/technology/an-ecg-on-your-wrist/. The article page itself has no Availability label.

entries.label: Sanitation without sewers
entries.quote: 2.3 billion people lack safe sanitation, and many die as a result

entries.label: Smooth-talking AI assistants
entries.quote: AI assistants can now perform conversation-based tasks like booking a restaurant reservation or coordinating a package drop-off rather than just obey simple commands

notes: Ten entries. Quote is the 'Why it matters' line for this edition. Availability for New-wave nuclear power and An ECG on your wrist could not be read verbatim (the list page fetch returned paraphrase; the article pages have no label); availability is null and the paraphrase is in the note.
